declarations.description:
A small ⓘ button that opens a help bubble on click or tap: the explanation behind a field label, a setting or a
column header. Unlike `c2-tooltip` the bubble can hold links and buttons, and unlike `c2-hover-card` it opens on a
press, so it works on touch and is meant for everyone, not as a preview for pointer users.

The bubble's content is a live region that is filled when the bubble opens, so a screen reader announces it
without moving focus; Tab from the button continues into any link inside. Pressing the button again, Escape (which
returns focus to the button), a press outside and focus moving elsewhere close it. The button carries
`aria-expanded`, and its name is the `label` attribute or the translatable "More information".

The bubble is a `popover="manual"` element in the top layer, placed beside the button by floating-ui and flipped
when there is no room, so a scrolling or `overflow: hidden` ancestor never clips it. It has a light surface by
default, so links in it keep the page's own colours.
declarations.name: Toggletip

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-toggletip__button--size

cssProperties.description: Colour of the ⓘ (or of slotted text).
cssProperties.name: --c2-toggletip__button--color

cssProperties.description: Colour while the bubble is open.
cssProperties.name: --c2-toggletip__button__expanded--color

cssProperties.description: Distance between the button and the tip of the arrow.
cssProperties.name: --c2-toggletip--offset

cssProperties.description: Side of the arrow square; `0px` hides it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-toggletip__arrow--size

cssParts.description: The button that opens and closes the bubble.
cssParts.name: button

cssParts.description: The region wrapping the `icon` slot inside the button: the ⓘ by default.
cssParts.name: icon

cssParts.description: The arrow pointing at the button.
cssParts.name: arrow

cssParts.description: The live region wrapping the default slot inside the bubble.
cssParts.name: content

slots.description: The help content: text, links, a short list.
Replaces the ⓘ inside the button: another icon, or a few words such as "What's this?".
slots.name: icon

members.name: label
members.description:
Accessible name of the button. Defaults to the translatable "More information", unless the `icon` slot holds
words, which then name the button themselves.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred side of the button; flips when there is no room.

members.name: open
members.description: Visible state. Set it to open or close the bubble from code; that fires `show` / `hide` too.

members.name: iconHasText
members.description: Whether the `icon` slot holds words, which name the button better than a hidden label would.
